books.title: Out of the East: Reveries and Studies in New Japan
books.author: Lafcadio Hearn
books.synopsis: Hearn dreams his way through Japan in eleven sketches, from the fisher-boy Urashima's vanished centuries to a hotel balcony by the sea. He quizzes Kyushu students on Western stories, watches jiujutsu masters throw men with a touch, and follows soldiers marching to the Chino-Japanese war. He keeps asking what the Japanese mind sees that the West cannot.
